text: Finance, right you are. New intern, that'll be Sofia then. What's she after?
style: Service desk analyst at a small British firm, early forties, British Indian, from the West Midlands. Speak with a consistent West Midlands (Birmingham) accent throughout — do not shift to any other accent. Bright mid-range pitch; easy, chatty pace. The friendliest voice in the building, keen to help whoever rings.
